accident_report: Vehicle A (overtaking car) is in Lane 2, 10 meters behind Vehicle B which is also in Lane 2. Vehicle A is traveling at 80 km/h while Vehicle B is traveling at 60 km/h. Vehicle C (third vehicle) is in Lane 3, 20 meters ahead of Vehicle A and traveling at 80 km/h. Vehicle A approaches Vehicle B from behind in Lane 2 and decides to overtake. Vehicle A signals and moves into Lane 3 where Vehicle C is traveling. As Vehicle A accelerates to pass Vehicle B, it drifts too far to the left within Lane 3 and makes contact with Vehicle C, which was traveling parallel to Vehicle A in the same lane. Vehicle A attempts to correct its position but fails to avoid a sideswipe collision with Vehicle C. The result is a sideswipe collision between Vehicle A and Vehicle C. Both vehicles suffer minor damage and need to pull over to the shoulder. Traffic in Lane 3 is temporarily disrupted.
